_comment: Per-million-token USD pricing for Anthropic Claude models. Cache-write tiers: cw5 = ephemeral 5m, cw1h = ephemeral 1h. cr = cache read. Long-context (1M) variants priced separately under <model>[1m]. Service-tier multipliers (batch=0.5x, priority=1.0x but eligible for surcharge) applied at compute time. Verify against https://www.anthropic.com/pricing before invoicing. EFFECTIVE-DATED PRICING: a model may be a flat price object (in effect for all time) OR a list of dated entries [{"effective":"ISO8601","in":..,"out":..,"cw5":..,"cw1h":..,"cr":..}, ...]. Each turn is priced at the entry whose 'effective' date is the latest one <= the turn's timestamp. To change a price, APPEND a new dated entry — never edit an existing one — so past ledger rows reproduce exactly and the new rate never applies retroactively.
_unverified: claude-fable-5-1 added 2026-09-03 from the bundled claude-api skill reference (cached 2026-06-24): same tier and per-token rate as claude-fable-5 ($10/$50), cache reads $0.25/MTok; cache-write tiers assumed at the standard 1.25x/2x of input. NOT verified against the pricing page; verify before invoicing rows dated 2026-09-03 or later. claude-opus-5 and claude-opus-5[1m] were added 2026-07-25 at the owner's instruction to default to the last Opus rate (claude-opus-4-8). NOT verified against the pricing page. If the real Opus 5 rate differs, do not edit these entries — append a dated entry per the policy above, and note that rows already billed at this default will not be restated. claude-sonnet-5 added 2026-08-03 from Anthropic's published rates ($3/$15 sticker; introductory $2/$10 through 2026-08-31, so the intro rate is the first dated entry and the sticker rate takes effect 2026-09-01). claude-sonnet-5[1m] defaults to the base rate — no long-context premium documented for Sonnet 5; verify before invoicing 1M-window usage.
